rooms.title: The Last Muster
rooms.description: The mountain shut like a fist. Two names are missing from the last shift. Read the slate east; the guild stairs run north. Beyond the gate lies the buried kingdom.

rooms.title: Slate of the Uncounted
rooms.description: First witness: the baker. Second witness: the pumpwright. Find their waymarks in the guild halls. Take those passages in order through the two seals.

rooms.title: The Guild Landing
rooms.description: Copper to the west, the smell of wells to the north, fired clay to the east. All three trades ate at this one long table.

rooms.title: The Widow's Mint
rooms.description: A die bears a baker's floury thumb instead of a crown. The baker's waymark reads west.

rooms.title: Nine-Chain Pump
rooms.description: Eight chains hang slack. The ninth still lifts water to a child's tin bath. The pumpwright's waymark reads east.

rooms.title: The Letter Kiln
rooms.description: Clay name tiles stand in rows. Some bear fingerprints too small to write. The tilemaker's waymark reads north.

rooms.title: First Witness Seal
rooms.description: Three crawlways pierce the arch. Take the way of the first witness; the other passages tip back toward muster.

rooms.title: Second Witness Seal
rooms.description: A smaller arch bears a second thumbprint. Take the way of the second witness.

rooms.title: The Hearth Roll
rooms.description: No gold. A roll of copper names records that the baker led the children out and the pumpwright stayed to close the gate. You have found the missing shift.

rooms.title: Gatehouse of the Bent Key
rooms.description: A notice in ten hands says the Ring Road is public, even to a king. Follow it onward to the cisterns or backward toward the crown vault.

rooms.title: Tide Gauge
rooms.description: Flood notches rise higher than a dwarf can reach. The ring turns from muster toward the foundry.

rooms.title: Brine Stair
rooms.description: Salt casts of bare feet climb out of the dark. One set stops to let smaller feet pass.

rooms.title: Counting Weir
rooms.description: Seven stone teeth comb the flow. A wooden eighth was whittled in haste.

rooms.title: Washhouse of Blue Cups
rooms.description: Cup handles point toward their owners' empty stools. A warm pipe ticks behind the benches.

rooms.title: The Twin Sluices
rooms.description: One wheel feeds the palace; the other feeds the street. Only the street wheel is worn smooth.

rooms.title: Pearl Sump
rooms.description: Blind mussels have plated a dropped measuring rod. Their shells click in the current.

rooms.title: Breathing Pipe
rooms.description: The pipe hums whenever the reservoir rises. Three old hammocks hang above the flood line.

rooms.title: Recorder's Float
rooms.description: A cork float still scratches a silver drum. The last great wave is a line like a knife cut.

rooms.title: The Listening Dam
rooms.description: Put an ear to the parapet and the mountain sounds like distant rain.

rooms.title: Cup of First Water
rooms.description: The first drinking cup hangs on a chain long enough to reach a child standing below the lip.

rooms.title: Bellfounders' Arch
rooms.description: A bell without a clapper serves as the road arch. Rainwater rings it from above.

rooms.title: Wax Pattern Yard
rooms.description: Dust has preserved the shadows of wax patterns which melted generations ago.

rooms.title: Beekeeper's Loft
rooms.description: The foundry bought wax by weight. The beekeeper scratched every bee's share into a beam.

rooms.title: Green Sand Floor
rooms.description: The last bell mould lies face down. Its rim reads HOME before the rest disappears into sand.

rooms.title: The Casting Pit
rooms.description: A channel of cooled bronze curls around the boots of an absent caster.

rooms.title: Steam Curtain
rooms.description: Drops falling on hot stone used to hide the casters from the singers until the first note.

rooms.title: Bell Hanger's Beam
rooms.description: Leather collars of nine sizes hang from pegs. The tiniest would fit a goat.

rooms.title: Tuning Bench
rooms.description: Rows of shallow hammer dimples make a constellation across the lip of a mourning bell.

rooms.title: Choir of Hammers
rooms.description: Every hammer rests head down except one, hanging ready to sound the all-clear.

rooms.title: Cradle of the Silent Bell
rooms.description: The warning bell was lowered here, not stolen. Its ropes went to the evacuation lifts.

rooms.title: Spoor Lantern
rooms.description: A mushroom lamp leans over the Ring Road, shedding pale spores on passing boots.

rooms.title: Terrace of Felt Soil
rooms.description: The beds are stitched with wool to keep hungry earth from running downhill.

rooms.title: Mycelium Loom
rooms.description: White threads pull against a frame, still trying to weave the shape of a missing glove.

rooms.title: Snail Trough
rooms.description: Great flat shells rasp algae off a limestone manger. A salt line keeps them out of the beds.

rooms.title: Widows' Rows
rooms.description: Each black cap grows from a ring set in the earth. Not one wedding ring has been taken.

rooms.title: Spore Library
rooms.description: Stoppered jars are labelled by smell for farmers who worked in the dark.

rooms.title: Rootwater Well
rooms.description: A rope passes through a living root instead of a pulley. Water beads red at the knot.

rooms.title: Nightbread Press
rooms.description: The ration moulds shrink with each date stamped on the handles.

rooms.title: Mica Oven
rooms.description: The oven's thin windows made bread visible without spending a breath of heat.

rooms.title: Bed of Last Resort
rooms.description: Someone planted the last loaf instead of eating it. A small forest of caps lifts the lid.

rooms.title: Counterweight Porch
rooms.description: A square shaft opens over the road. A stone chalkboard lists loads in people, not tons.

rooms.title: Copper Departure Deck
rooms.description: Copper heel plates mark where passengers waited in lines of six.

rooms.title: Rope Drum Gallery
rooms.description: The lift cable is spliced to a bell rope. The splice is signed by both guilds.

rooms.title: The Passenger Cage
rooms.description: Children measured their height in chalk on the inside of the barred door.

rooms.title: Brake Shoe Chapel
rooms.description: A brake shoe cracked along a prayer for soft landings. The crack stops short of the last word.

rooms.title: Spring Buffer
rooms.description: The lowest spring holds a flattened tin lunchbox. Its painted apple survived the fall.

rooms.title: Signal Box Four
rooms.description: The handles are polished at two heights: the operator's and her apprentice's.

rooms.title: Balance Socket
rooms.description: A missing weight left a perfectly square shadow. Loose stones have been counted to replace it.

rooms.title: Split Rail
rooms.description: One rail points to the palace, one to the hospice. The switch is pinned toward the sickbeds.

rooms.title: Last Evacuation Car
rooms.description: Twenty slings hang from hooks. The manifest lists twenty sleepers and no baggage.

rooms.title: Door of Borrowed Names
rooms.description: Readers surrendered their titles here. The king signed the register as a stonecutter.

rooms.title: Obsidian Lending Desk
rooms.description: Fingertips have worn shallow troughs where readers waited for a book.

rooms.title: Soot Kitchen
rooms.description: Black stills collect lamp soot. A child's recipe calls for one night's worth of reading.

rooms.title: Folded Map Room
rooms.description: Thin sheets of hammered copper fold into a model of an unbroken mountain.

rooms.title: Spindle Index
rooms.description: Turned stone cylinders catalogue voices as well as letters. One is filed under laughter.

rooms.title: Palimpsest Bench
rooms.description: A scraped decree still shows through a nursery rhyme when held against the lamp.

rooms.title: Reading Well
rooms.description: A narrow cone of daylight reaches this lectern for one minute in midsummer.

rooms.title: Bindery of Brass Hinges
rooms.description: Books of slate hang open to keep their hinges from seizing shut.

rooms.title: Overdue Shelf
rooms.description: An unsigned loan slip requests the names of the workers who closed the gates.

rooms.title: The Unwritten Volume
rooms.description: An empty folio waits for the testimony of the city below. Its dedication reads: To those who return.

rooms.title: White Milepost
rooms.description: Salt has eaten every distance off the milepost except the arrow pointing home.

rooms.title: Pack Scale
rooms.description: Two iron pans hang level. One carries a salt brick; one holds a pair of boots.

rooms.title: The Rose Cut
rooms.description: Rose salt carries dark grains like stars. Pick marks avoid a seam shaped like a sleeping face.

rooms.title: Inn of Dry Cloaks
rooms.description: A rack of stiff white cloaks surrounds a fire laid but never lit.

rooms.title: Rope Bridge of Teeth
rooms.description: Salt crystals have knitted the hanging bridge into a rigid white jaw.

rooms.title: Surefoot Fold
rooms.description: Small square hoofprints lead from the pens toward the freight road, no driver beside them.

rooms.title: Empty Toll Booth
rooms.description: The final toll was struck through for all who carried water.

rooms.title: Sled Runners' Shed
rooms.description: Polished runners hang upside down. A spare set has been shortened to fit a cradle.

rooms.title: The Salt Hairpin
rooms.description: Deep sled grooves swing wide of a little shrine built in the bend.

rooms.title: Traveler's Salt Bowl
rooms.description: A salt bowl full of fresh water stands undissolved: an unseen glass lining, not a miracle.

rooms.title: Glaze Test Wall
rooms.description: A hundred thumb-sized tiles run from soot black to sky blue. No dwarf here had ever seen the sky.

rooms.title: Wedging Floor
rooms.description: Bare heels kneaded the clay in spirals. The floor preserves their last turn.

rooms.title: Slip Cistern
rooms.description: A thousand pale rings show where the clay water settled between firings.

rooms.title: Twin Potter's Wheels
rooms.description: A large wheel and a small one share a treadle so the master could steady an apprentice's hand.

rooms.title: Drying Orchard
rooms.description: Branching iron racks bear rows of unfinished birds instead of fruit.

rooms.title: Seal Cutter's Bench
rooms.description: The royal stamp lies face down. Beside it is a new stamp shaped like an open door.

rooms.title: Dragon Flue
rooms.description: A dragon of brick once drew smoke through its long, hot throat.

rooms.title: Cooling Ledge
rooms.description: A row of cups cooled so quickly that each has cracked into the shape of a river.

rooms.title: Shards Court
rooms.description: Broken plates make a mosaic of the city. Most fragments are turned with the royal crest down.

rooms.title: The Unfired Urn
rooms.description: An urn made to hold the king's ashes was never fired. Small hands pinched its rim into petals.

rooms.title: Quiet Threshold
rooms.description: Felt wraps the hinges. Even the closing of a door was not allowed to wake a patient.

rooms.title: Lantern Ward
rooms.description: Green glass lanterns hang low enough for a nurse to shade with one hand.

rooms.title: Bitter Moss Pantry
rooms.description: A jar of bitter moss is tied to a jar of honey with one length of twine.

rooms.title: Warming Press
rooms.description: Linen lies between slabs of soapstone. A coal drawer beneath still smells of juniper.

rooms.title: Round of Chalk Beds
rooms.description: A chalk circle around each bed leaves just enough room for a visitor's stool.

rooms.title: Drops Room
rooms.description: A drop falls into a bowl at every breath. The healer used the rhythm instead of a clock.

rooms.title: Bell Cord Passage
rooms.description: Each bed had its own note. Someone braided all the cords together for the evacuation.

rooms.title: Night Nurse's Bench
rooms.description: A cushion is worn through at one end where a second watcher always sat.

rooms.title: Screen of Tin Stars
rooms.description: A lamp behind the screen would cast constellations across a bedbound child's ceiling.

rooms.title: The Empty Cot
rooms.description: A tally on the cot says twenty departed, twenty arrived. Below it someone added: even the little one.

rooms.title: Door of Abandoned Crowns
rooms.description: The ring bends home toward muster. Inside the vault, every door stands open.

rooms.title: Assayer's Desk
rooms.description: The scales weigh gold against black bread. A note records the day bread became dearer.

rooms.title: Cold Coin Run
rooms.description: Grooves sorted coins by size. A child's button fits the largest groove perfectly.

rooms.title: Velvet Cases
rooms.description: Empty cases stand unlocked. The velvet carries the outlines of tools, not jewels.

rooms.title: Silver Catch Drain
rooms.description: Mesh caught the filings washed from the workers' hands. In it lies a single iron key.

rooms.title: Abdication Die
rooms.description: The final die minted no face at all. Both sides show a hand passing bread.

rooms.title: Lock of Ten Guilds
rooms.description: Ten keyholes surround a common spindle. The mechanism can only open from the public side.

rooms.title: Low Throne Step
rooms.description: The throne was sawn into stools. Only the stone step was too heavy to carry away.

rooms.title: Council Table of Scraps
rooms.description: Ten different woods make a circle. At every joint a guild mark overlaps its neighbour's.

rooms.title: The Mountain's Heart
rooms.description: What the kingdom hid was not a crown. Beneath the council table a child's copper cup waits for the next hand to fill it.
